contexts.text: Rational truth not able to comprehend. Signified.
The Spiritual consists in comprehending things abstractedly from the letter...
It involves more than the universal Heaven is capable of comprehending...
This is not comprehended...
Without appearances, the Spiritual Church would not comprehend doctrine...
Divine good and truth cannot be comprehended... unless they are in appearances. Treated of.
The finite is not capable of comprehending the infinite or the eternal... wherefore they are presented before the Angels in finite appearances, which, however, are far above man's comprehension.
Without a general idea of a thing, man comprehends nothing singular...
Without an idea from finite things, principally from the things of space and time, man can comprehend nothing concerning Divine things, still less concerning the infinite.
What is historical ought to be as nothing for the things not historical to be comprehended in their series.
They see indefinite things which man can never comprehend.
These things can never be comprehended by one who is not in the light of Heaven...

They could not comprehend how the Human could be Divine... For whatever they did not comprehend by some idea received through the external sensuous things of the body, they supposed to be of no account.
The rational natural man comprehends that there are a Heaven and a Hell... He comprehends that there are Spirits and Angels who are invisible... But the sensuous man does not comprehend... AC 5094:4.
He can have no faith, for there is no comprehension...
This can scarcely be comprehended... HH 265. HH 379:2.
They do not at all comprehend... HH 380:2.
These are such things as can be comprehended by Angels...
At last I perceived such things as I could not even comprehend by thought from natural light.
The ideas of their thought comprehend such things as man cannot apprehend.
Hence every (angelic) word comprehends in it so many things.
Cannot be comprehended in thought...
They then understood such things as they could not comprehend before. HH 455.
This arcanum is comprehensible only to those who are in spiritual light...
They who had at heart denied the Divine... had become so stupid that they could scarcely comprehend any civil truth, still less any spiritual truth.
They said they had not comprehended... this...
This cannot be comprehended with the understanding by any such...
It could not have been comprehended, because it would have fallen into an unknown idea...
Spiritual ideas, which comprehend a number of things together...
They who think from wisdom cannot believe unless they in some way comprehend...
If he does not comprehend that it is true, he says, I do not know whether it is true, therefore I do not as yet believe; I do not comprehend how I am to believe...
It is a common saying that no one can comprehend spiritual or theological things, because they are supernatural; but spiritual truths can be comprehended equally as natural truths...
This cannot be comprehended by a merely natural idea, but it can by a spiritual idea: the reason it cannot be comprehended by a natural idea is that there is space in that idea... DLW 8. Illustrated.
Still, man is able to comprehend this by natural thought, provided he admits into it something of spiritual light.
The reason man is able to comprehend, is that it is not his body that thinks...
This cannot be comprehended, unless...
Abstract things, being universals, are usually better comprehended than applied ones.
Unless these things be demonstrated, they may indeed be acknowledged, but not comprehended, and what is not comprehended is like a wheel turned by the hand.
The beast was taken ().
It is said that the dragon was laid hold of ()... by which is signified that those who are meant by him were collected together and withheld.
They then cannot interiorly comprehend any Divine truth.
They who thus comprehended this matter...
Thus may be more clearly comprehended...
In order that this may he rightly comprehended...
Who does not comprehend that... TCR 412. TCR 445.
From these things when understood may be comprehended.
Every man is such that he can see and comprehend truth when he hears it; but he who is confirmed in falsities cannot bring it into the understanding so that it will stay there...
That those who are in falsities of evil do not so perceive or receive it, is meant by the darkness comprehended it not ().
